proof_scope: issue #1531: a WebGPT attachment bundle rejected before browser dispatch (surf zip file-count limit) classifies as webgpt_attachment_bundle_rejected with a recovery packet naming the file-count cause, not a generic browser_handler_timeout with a stale open-bind next_command

claims.proves: Ask's browser failure classifier maps surf's attach_file_preflight_failed to webgpt_attachment_bundle_rejected, cites 'zip contains N files; maximum is M' in the recovery instruction, and emits a resubmit next_command (never open-bind/--create-tab)
claims.does_not_prove: a full live WebGPT run with a 9-file zip, or a unified error taxonomy across the whole pipeline (separate follow-up)

capability_claims.description: Ask names the attachment-bundle-shape cause instead of a generic timeout/open-bind for provider file-count rejections.

cases.name: webgpt-attachment-bundle-rejection-classified-1531
command: cd .. && UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/tmp/ask-1531-eval-venv uv run --with pytest --project . python -m pytest -q tests/test_attachment_bundle_recovery_1531.py
